enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Move hand to face. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust to cool. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Check appearance. Open drawer. Take out bag. Pack laptop. Pack wallet. Pack phone. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Change into scrubs. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Take patient vitals. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Wash hands. Take vitals. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work. Walk to next patient.
Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock front door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Walk out.

Pick up plates. Scrape food. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wet sponge. Add soap. Wash pan. Rinse pan. Place in rack. Wipe counter. Wipe table. Sweep floor. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off bedroom light. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Remain still.
